featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Ambrosia Aesthetics in February 2023 for treatment of excessive sweating (hyperhidrosis).  Before starting, the doctor assured me about the results and advised that Botox injections were required on both hands.

I trusted the doctor’s assurance and done the treatment. Cost was very high.

However, even after a few days, there was no improvement. I was then informed that my skin was “not responding” to the treatment. Later, the doctor also mentioned that a small test area should ideally have been injected first to observe the response.

The patient should have been informed about all these possibilities and limitations before the full procedure and payment.

If there was uncertainty regarding the results, it should have been communicated in advance and I had saved my huge money.
This was a very expensive treatment for me, and the overall experience was disappointing.
Just Sharing my experience
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Vaibhav,
Thank you for your feedback. I am greatful that you brought up the topic of how "Botox hyperhidrosis treatment for excessive sweating" may not be successful in all treated cases.

I would like to take this opportunity to go over some details of your treatment, the possible reasons for inadequate response, and also clarify an important misunderstanding regarding the "test dose". 

We first met for your consultation regarding Palmar hyperhidrosis (excessive sweating) on 3rd March 2023. On that day, we had a detailed consultation regarding what is hyperhidrosis, why it occurs, and all the treatment options such as topical applications, oral medication, surgical treatment and Botulinum toxin injections.

We also discussed in detail, how the Botox treatment is performed, how long it lasts, any possible adverse effects and how the dosage is calculated for each patient; especially for first time patients.

After the detailed discussion we decided to proceed with the beginer dose of 80 units per hand. i.e. 160 units over both hands. If you remember the discussion and also read through the detailed treatment plan sent in your email, you will recall that I clearly mentioned verbally, and in writing that, 'Note: This is basic dose. Additional dose may be needed after 1 month'.

Your treatment cost was as follows: Rs. 360 per unit (-15% discount) = Rs. 306 per unit x 160 units = Rs. 48,960 + 18% GST = Rs. 57,773. (This is the amount you paid for the treatment).

One month after the treatment, on 1st April 2023, we had scheduled the follow-up appointment for the evaluation of treatment outcome (and possible add-on dose as mentioned in your treatment plan). At that time you mentioned that the sweating is persistent and you do not wish to add-on more Botox dose.

After that, three months later, on 3rd June 2023, we met again. You mentioned that sweating is still persistent. At that time, I explained you two main reasons for inadequate response in hyperhydrosis Botox treatment: 
1. The need of more dose (of the same formulation), i.e Botox.
2. Failure of response to Botox, and the need for an alternate Botulinum formulation (such as Dysport).

On that day, I also suggested that we will do the "test dose" of both these options to *diagnose why you had inadequate response to the treatment*.

In order to help diagnose the reason specific to your case, I performed additional dose injections on one finger *free of cost*. And I called you back after 15 days to give me a feedback and possibly perform the next test which was to change the formulation (and check for positive response).

But, after that day, you did not stay in touch with us, and never visited us. Now, 2 years later, on 21st May 2025, you direectly expressed your views through this Google review.

Please understand, as a doctor, I strive to counsel my patients in utmost detail, perform all treatments in the most scientific manner and follow-up meticulously for treatment outcomes. Yet, it is unfortunate that some patients may achieve results that are less than the expected.

Regards,
Dr. Niketa Sonavane.
